metadata.title: Trading OS — did the strategy fail, or did you?
metadata.description: A trading journal that scores every trade twice: what the strategy would have produced, and what your execution actually produced.

footer.tagline: A trading journal that separates strategy edge from execution.
footer.disclaimer1: Trading OS is a journaling and analytics tool. It does not provide financial advice, execute orders, or connect to a broker. Trading involves risk of loss, and past performance does not indicate future results.
footer.disclaimer2: Product in active development. Figures shown anywhere on this site are fictional demo data.

hero.title: Know whether it was the strategy or you.
hero.description: Most journals record what happened, so they can only ever show profit and loss. Trading OS records what should have happened too — then measures the distance between them.

problem.title: Profit does not prove the trade was correct
problem.description: Two traders can end the month at the same balance while doing completely different things. One is running a system. The other is being rescued by luck. A journal that records only outcomes cannot separate them.
problem.matrixTitle: Every trade lands in one of four cells
problem.matrixDescription: System outcome and trader outcome are recorded separately, so the two most important cells stay visible instead of collapsing into a single profit figure.

brokeRules.title: Paid for breaking the rules

faq.title: What this product does and does not do

whyManual.question: Why is journal entry manual?
whyManual.answer: Because the number the product is built around — what the strategy's rules would have done — does not exist anywhere else. A broker feed knows what you filled; it does not know what your plan told you to do.

brokerImport.question: Can I import trades from my broker?
brokerImport.answer: No. There is no broker API integration, no MT4/MT5 sync, and no CSV import. Trades are entered by hand — a deliberate scope decision, not a feature in progress.

systemPerformance.question: What is System Performance?
systemPerformance.answer: The result the strategy would have produced if its rules had been followed exactly. It answers "does this strategy have an edge at all?", independent of execution.

traderPerformance.question: What is Trader Performance?
traderPerformance.answer: The result your actual decisions produced — real entry, stop, exit and costs. Compared with System Performance, it shows how much edge survived contact with you.

tradingViewLinks.question: Can I attach TradingView charts?
tradingViewLinks.answer: You can paste a TradingView chart URL onto any trade. It is a stored link, not an integration — nothing is read from TradingView.

freeTrial.question: Is the free trial available now?
freeTrial.answer: Not yet. A {trialDays}-day trial with no card required is planned. Authentication and payment processing are not connected, so no trial can start today.

mobile.question: Can I use it on my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes. Logging a trade is designed for a phone. Analytics are designed for a desktop screen and stay readable on a tablet.

aiAnalysis.question: Does it use AI to analyse my trades?
aiAnalysis.answer: No. There is no AI analysis in this product. Figures shown in this preview are labelled fictional fixtures, not calculated results.

cta.title: Find out which problem you actually have
